New Developments


The New Developments section gives agents direct access to active and upcoming property projects listed by developers on PropertyList.

Inside this section, you can:

  • Browse all available new development projects in one place

  • View detailed project information (brochures, floor plans, price lists, specifications, availability, and media)

  • See sales commission % and payment structure 

  • See unit-level availability and pricing where provided

  • Register buyer interest and track enquiries

  • Share development listings directly with clients

  • Add units to your CRM and manage them within your sales pipeline

Developers list their projects directly, ensuring information is accurate, up to date, and straight from the source.


See all New Developments here



Developers List for Free on PropertyList.es


Developers List for Free Forever on PropertyList.es

Are you a property developer looking to showcase your new-build projects to a wider audience—at zero cost? 

PropertyList.es is your opportunity to get direct exposure without any listing fees.


Why List on PropertyList.es?

  • 100% Free to List – No hidden charges, no subscription plans. Simply upload your developments and start generating interest.

  • Paid Fetaures - Highlight Developments – Make your project stand out with enhanced visibility on the homepage and in newsletters and much more coming soon.

  • Access to Active Agents - Your properties become instantly searchable and shareable by hundreds of local and international agents working with direct clients.

  • No Middlemen - Agents can send your properties directly to buyers, boosting visibility and increasing the chances of a quicker sale.

  • Easy to Onboard - We support various data feeds and can help get your listings live fast.

  • Pay Only on Results – You only pay your agreed commission once a minimum 10% deposit has been received and cleared. No upfront costs, no risk.

Designed to Help You Sell

Whether you're launching a new phase or selling your final units, PropertyList.es helps amplify your reach - at no cost to list.

👉 Start listing now. It’s free, fast, and built to help you sell.

Free Access for Agents

Looking for high-quality new-build properties to offer your clients? 

PropertyList.es, you get completely free access to a growing portfolio of new developments from trusted developers across Spain and soon Europe.

Why Use PropertyList.es?

  • Free to Use - No sign-up fees, no subscriptions. Search, save, and share listings without paying a cent.

  • New-Builds from Top Developers - Gain instant access to the latest developments, including off-plan and under-construction properties.

  • Ready-to-Share Listings - Each property is fully detailed and shareable with your direct clients, helping you present opportunities professionally and instantly.

  • Save Time - No need to chase developers or request marketing materials. Everything’s in one place, ready to go.

Built for Agents Who Want to Sell Faster

Whether you’re working with investors, relocators, or first-time buyers, PropertyList.es gives you the tools to present opportunities professionally and close deals efficiently.


👉 Start exploring new developments today and match your clients with the perfect property.
